Fluttershy is a female Pegasus pony and one of the main characters of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. She lives in a small cottage near the Everfree Forest and takes care of animals, including her pet bunny Angel. She represents the element of kindness.__TOC__

Lauren Faust was inspired to create Fluttershy by the G1 pony Posey. In the preliminary character designs posted by Faust, Fluttershy originally was an Earth pony like Posey and shared the same color scheme and cutie mark as Posey. Fluttershy shares a name with the G3 pony Fluttershy. In her final design, Fluttershy kept the same color scheme as Posey, but has the same cutie mark as G3. Even though both of her inspirations are Earth ponies, Fluttershy's final design is as a Pegasus.

The guidebook The Art of Equestria reveals some of the other names considered for Fluttershy: Summer Azure (Summer for short), Spring Blossoms, Petalwing, and Meadowbrook. Much later in the show, the last name on the list was given to Mage Meadowbrook, who is the Pillar of Old Equestria counterpart to Fluttershy.

Fluttershy is a female Pegasus pony and one of the main characters of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. She lives in a small cottage near the Everfree Forest and takes care of animals, including her pet bunny Angel. She represents the element of kindness.__TOC__

Lauren Faust was inspired to create Fluttershy by the G1 pony Posey. In the preliminary character designs posted by Faust, Fluttershy originally was an Earth pony like Posey and shared the same color scheme and cutie mark as Posey. Fluttershy shares a name with the G3 pony Fluttershy. In her final design, Fluttershy kept the same color scheme as Posey, but has the same cutie mark as G3. Even though both of her inspirations are Earth ponies, Fluttershy's final design is as a Pegasus.

The guidebook The Art of Equestria reveals some of the other names considered for Fluttershy: Summer Azure (Summer for short), Spring Blossoms, Petalwing, and Meadowbrook. Much later in the show, the last name on the list was given to Mage Meadowbrook, who is the Pillar of Old Equestria counterpart to Fluttershy.
